name: formatter
description: Formats structured output (a JSON envelope from another agent, or any JSON) as Markdown, Slack Block Kit blocks or email HTML, in code: same JSON in, same text out. It never adds, rewrites or summarises content; every value in your JSON appears in the result, escaped for the target (Slack data can never ping a channel; email HTML has no scripts, images or external styles). Knows the layouts of the catalog agents' outputs (summaries, action items, promises, rankings, pre-mortems, drafts, memos) and has a generic layout for any other JSON; also converts pasted Markdown to Slack or email. Follow-ups re-render the same input: as slack, as email, as markdown, compact, no footer, the plain-text version, as json. It sends and posts nothing, and answers no other questions.

skills.name: Format structured output
skills.description: Renders a JSON envelope or any JSON as Markdown, Slack blocks or email HTML without changing its content, plus Markdown to Slack or email conversion.
